# SigTide

> One simple rule, checked every day on the 49 largest crypto coins: a coin is IN while its 10-day average price is above its 44-day average, and OUT (in cash) when it is below. The site shows what that rule did next to just holding Bitcoin and the average coin, each with its worst fall. Free, updated every day. Not financial advice.

SigTide publishes the rule's state for every coin, the past results after costs, a live practice test with no real money (started 2026-10-08), and every test it ran, including the ones that failed. Since 2023 Bitcoin alone made more than the rule; the rule's case is the smaller fall.

## Core pages

- [Is your coin IN or OUT today?](https://sigtide.com/): type a coin and see its state, since when, and what $100 did following the rule and just holding.
- [All 49 coins](https://sigtide.com/board/): every coin IN or OUT today, what switched, and the coins closest to a switch.
- [Our record](https://sigtide.com/record/): the practice test next to Bitcoin and the average coin, the long view since 2023, and every test we ran with its verdict.
- [Coin pages](https://sigtide.com/coins/btc/): one page per coin (for example /coins/btc/, /coins/pepe/): the answer, the chart, the $100 past test and the coin's last switches.
- [Is crypto risk-on or risk-off today?](https://sigtide.com/flip/): Bitcoin's 50-day vs 200-day average, as market context.
- [Crypto RSI heatmap today](https://sigtide.com/rsi/): average RSI(14) across the 49 coins.

## Email

- A free letter every Monday, and an email the day a reader's chosen coin switches IN or OUT. Nothing is sent before the reader confirms. [Privacy](https://sigtide.com/privacy/).

## Methodology and honesty

- [Negative results: no tradeable long edge in crypto risk-off](https://sigtide.com/research/no-edge-in-risk-off/): strategies tested and rejected, not just the ones that worked.
